ASSESSMENT

The patient is a 68-year-old with no past medical history documented in the available records who presented with community-acquired pneumonia. She is on day 3 of intravenous ceftriaxone and azithromycin. She has remained afebrile overnight, and her leukocytosis is trending downward. Clinical improvement is evident with resolution of fever and symptomatic improvement in her cough. She is tolerating the current regimen well and is a candidate for transition to oral therapy if she remains afebrile.

PLAN

1. Continue intravenous ceftriaxone and azithromycin today; transition to oral cefpodoxime tomorrow if patient remains afebrile.

2. Discuss discharge planning with family; anticipate discharge home this weekend pending continued clinical improvement and tolerance of oral antibiotics.
